summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of bulk QR printing feature for books in Koleksi buku. All 24 test cases passed successfully. Feature is fully functional for both admin and petugas roles.
passed_tests: Admin login and navigation to Koleksi buku
'Cetak QR massal' button visible and accessible for admin and petugas
Bulk QR view opens with full-screen overlay
Summary displays correctly (N judul · N label · P halaman A4)
Default scope 'Semua buku' is active on open
QR labels display with QR SVG, book title, and metadata (code · rak)
Rak filter works with multiple shelf options
Jumlah label selector switches between '1 label per judul' and 'Sesuai jumlah eksemplar'
'Tampilkan kode buku' checkbox toggles book code visibility on labels
Scope switch to 'Pilih per buku' shows picker interface
Empty state displayed when no books selected with disabled print button
Book picker search filters books by title, author, code
Individual book selection works with visual feedback
'Pilih semua yang tampil' button selects all visible books
'Kosongkan' button clears all selections
Multiple sheets logic works (1 sheet for ≤24 labels)
Escape key closes bulk QR view
Close button (X) closes bulk QR view
Per-book QR modal integration: 'Cetak N label' button opens bulk view with preselected book and 'stok' copies
Dark mode: controls readable, label sheets stay white for print preview
Mobile viewport (390px): view is usable with responsive layout
No critical console errors (only expected 401 on initial load)
Other Koleksi buku features unaffected (Tambah buku, Buku masuk, edit)
Petugas account can access bulk QR feature
